evidence: Next, a 110-nm-thick Al2O3 layer and a 25-nm-thick ZnO layer were deposited onto the Cr gates by spatial ALD at 200 ◦C from trimethylaluminum or diethylzinc (DEZ) and water. Unlike conventional ALD, no containment vessel is required for the spatial ALD process, and the deposition process is done at atmospheric pressure.
